info.name: StageBet — local betting API
info.description: Virtual-credit Crash betting API. Start PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and the Spring app first. Before betting, supply a tenantId, playerId, and an already funded/open roundId; the application does not expose public funding or round-control endpoints. Set accessToken to a valid JWT only when an issuer is configured. The default security configuration requires authentication for /api/** but has no local token-issuing flow. See README for setup and limitations.

request.description: Check that the local Spring application is responding. This endpoint does not require authentication.

exec: pm.test('Bet belongs to the requested player and round', function () {

header.description: Reuse this key to retry the same bet; use a new betId for a new bet.

request.description: Reserve USD 10.00 from the player's funded wallet and place one bet in an OPEN round. Replace tenantId, playerId, and roundId with real values; expectedRoundSequence must match the round's current sequence (normally 1 after opening). Returns 200 with status ACCEPTED. Common failures: 401/403 without valid authentication, 409 if the round is not OPEN or the sequence is stale, 422 for insufficient funds or responsible-gaming restrictions, and 429 for Redis rate limiting.

header.description: Reuse this key to retry the same cash-out without a second payout.

request.description: Cash out the accepted bet while its round is RUNNING. The round's sequence is normally 2 immediately after starting; change expectedRoundSequence if it has ticked. Returns 200 with status CASHED_OUT and a payout amount. A crash, stale sequence, or already settled bet returns 409; Redis may return 429. The round must be started through application services because there is no public round-control endpoint.
